cases.title_zh: 高速交通伤：院前预警到早期复评
cases.title_en: High-speed transport injury: pre-alert to early reassessment
cases.trigger_zh: 32岁男性，高速交通伤。院前报告提示烦躁、呼吸急促、右下肢活动性出血。预计2分钟后到达。
cases.trigger_en: A 32-year-old man after high-speed traffic injury. Prehospital report notes agitation, rapid breathing, and active right lower-limb bleeding. Arrival is expected in 2 minutes.

stages.information_zh: 机制和途中表现提示需要完整团队准备，但仍有许多未知信息。
stages.information_en: The mechanism and en-route appearance suggest whole-team readiness, with many unknowns remaining.
stages.preferred_choice_zh: 建立创伤团队角色、共享 xABCDE 板和资源准备语言。
stages.preferred_choice_en: Set trauma-team roles, a shared xABCDE board, and resource-readiness language.
stages.unsafe_choice_zh: 只围绕单一损伤区域准备。
stages.unsafe_choice_en: Prepare around only one suspected injury region.
stages.feedback_zh: 单线准备会削弱团队对外出血、气道、呼吸和循环的并行关注。
stages.feedback_en: Single-lane preparation weakens parallel attention to external bleeding, airway, breathing, and circulation.

stages.information_zh: 可见出血、呼吸表现和躁动信息同时进入团队画面。
stages.information_en: Visible bleeding, breathing appearance, and agitation enter the team picture together.
stages.preferred_choice_zh: 用观察事实报告 x/B/C 相关担心，并请团队复述已知和未知。
stages.preferred_choice_en: Report observed x/B/C concerns and ask the team to restate knowns and unknowns.
stages.unsafe_choice_zh: 在团队共享信息前直接选择全身 CT。
stages.unsafe_choice_en: Choose whole-body CT before the team has shared the information picture.
stages.feedback_zh: 过早跳到单一资源会造成时间消耗，并使立即威胁和复评问题被后移。
stages.feedback_en: Jumping early to one resource consumes time and pushes immediate threats and reassessment questions backward.

stages.information_zh: 团队行动和新信息出现后，学习者需要说明哪些风险改变，哪些仍未解决。
stages.information_en: After team action and new information, the learner explains what changed and what remains unresolved.
stages.preferred_choice_zh: 回到 xABCDE，报告改善、恶化或仍不确定的趋势。
stages.preferred_choice_en: Return to xABCDE and report improved, worsened, or still-uncertain trends.
stages.unsafe_choice_zh: 把一次行动后的短暂变化当作结束点。
stages.unsafe_choice_en: Treat a short change after one action as the end point.
stages.feedback_zh: 创伤初评是循环语言，新的信息会让团队重新排序。
stages.feedback_en: Trauma primary survey is loop language; new information can reorder the team picture.

cases.boundary: Educational simulation only; not patient-specific guidance, treatment protocol, or local pathway.
